experiment_template.research_question: With one common budgeted output-cap correction, does tokenizer-fitted state improve native evidence selection after recycling?
stop_conditions: Failed or corrective model tokens are omitted.
More than one incomplete-output correction occurs in a cell.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells.

records.falsifier: Correction is unbounded, failed usage is omitted, arm behavior differs, state exceeds its cap, treatment completion degrades, or the fixed paired native target is not met.
records.mechanism: Retain the failed response receipt and tokens, expose none of its incomplete body, append a fixed concise-action correction for one additional admitted request, and otherwise preserve H14 exact-generation token fitting. Apply the correction identically to control and treatment.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state with one budgeted output-cap correction common to both arms.
records.statement: With one common budgeted concise-action correction for a length-limited response, tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state can complete and improve useful native evidence selection.

experiment_template.research_question: Does preventive concise-tool guidance avoid output-cap failures?

records.falsifier: Length-limited responses persist or the preventive text adds tokens without completion benefit.
records.mechanism: Tell the model before every request to split large edits and keep each tool call below the fixed output cap.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state with one budgeted output-cap correction common to both arms.
records.statement: A shorter preventive tool-action instruction is sufficient to avoid length-limited outputs without a correction call.

experiment_template.research_question: Does fitted state with common correction produce no native improvement?

records.falsifier: The state-only arm improves frozen paired native outcomes under identical common correction policy.
records.mechanism: Bounded recovery can preserve observed facts but cannot supply the missing semantic interpretation or evidence choice.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; tokenizer-fitted exact-generation state with one budgeted output-cap correction common to both arms.
records.statement: Fitted state still does not improve native outcomes because semantic task reasoning is the limiting factor.

selection.reason: H14 remains untested and its fitter passed exact replay. H18 first repairs the observed common length-limited response boundary while preserving H17 prevention and the semantic null as alternatives.
